selection.note: every LongMemEval-S question, sorted by question_id; abstention questions are retrieved but not scored

document_unit.rule: one user turn plus the assistant turns that follow it; leading assistant turns form their own round

arms.store: plain round bodies, no embedder, no projection (v1 shape)
the same plain round bodies plus ProjectionSpec(name='dense', SEARCHABLE, vector=True) declared before writes; the full node body is embedded; vector coverage checked per store

arms.method: table.search(query_type='fts'), native FTS index, library defaults

retrieval.store: fresh store per question per arm, removed after

bootstrap.ci: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of paired mean differences

metrics.latency: first query and five repeats per store; hybrid query latency includes embedding the question

device.cuda_fallback: refused: a cuda:N request must resolve to an effective CUDA device with a selected UUID

claim_boundary.statement: adopt hybrid for the answer run iff (a) preference session Recall@5 delta CI lower bound > 0, (b) no other type's delta CI upper bound < 0, (c) overall delta >= 0
claim_boundary.reason: EARP found hybrid null-or-negative on real traces, so adoption is decided by this pre-stated rule
claim_boundary.scope: retrieval only; no answerer or judge
